LanguageData.HE_Faction_Tianxia.label: Celestial Tianxia
LanguageData.HE_Faction_Tianxia.description: The realm of all under heaven, heir of the colony ship Kunlun. Its scholar-officials govern a vast and patient people, and its caravans carry tea, silk and porcelain along the silk roads.
LanguageData.HE_Player_Tianxia.label: Tianxia settlers
LanguageData.HE_Player_Tianxia.description: A small household of Tianxia settlers sent to open a new frontier for the empire.
